remarks: For sale is a well-maintained condo unit in a quiet neighborhood in Azusa. This is an upstairs unit with durable vinyl flooring, no carpet, 2 bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, plenty of storage space, and great mountain views. The property comes with central air conditioning and heating, an electric range, microwave, and dishwasher. Two assigned parking spots come with the property; one covered and one uncovered. Laundry is on-site and easy to use. The community features basketball courts, access to a pool, and is very dog friendly. Near Costco, APU, and golfing.
